skills.name: search-miners
skills.description: Search LightningASIC mining hardware and product catalog by algorithm, hashrate range, power budget, or price. Use when a user asks about miner specs, hashrate, power consumption, or model comparison.
skills.primary_prompt: What algorithm, hashrate, or budget does the user need?

skills.name: check-stock
skills.description: Check real-time availability and lead time for LightningASIC products. Use when the user is ready to purchase or asks 'is it in stock', 'when can I get it', or about shipping time.
skills.primary_prompt: Which model and quantity is the user asking about?

skills.name: get-quote
skills.description: Request a bulk pricing quote for mining hardware orders. Use when the user mentions quantity greater than 10, 'wholesale', 'bulk order', 'dealer pricing', or shipping cost estimates for large orders.
skills.primary_prompt: Model, quantity, shipping destination, and contact method?

skills.name: book-tech-support
skills.description: Schedule or route a technical support session for LightningASIC hardware: setup, troubleshooting, firmware, or RMA. Use when the user reports miner or wallet issues.
skills.primary_prompt: What is the user's issue: setup, troubleshooting, firmware, or RMA?
